claims.evidence: Witness report shows a disassembled-looking engine assembly with hoses/wiring and no clear branding/model markings; no import/"tokumbo" proof is visible.

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing key components (starter/alternator/sensors/ECU/hoses/brackets), which would make it hard to install and could require extra spending.
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the engine assembly from multiple angles plus a laid-out inventory shot of all included parts (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, belts/hoses, mounting brackets) with close-ups of connectors and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only (worst case: not ready to run).

risks.risk: Unknown mechanical condition (compression/health, internal wear, head gasket issues, leaks, overheating history).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine being started/running (or at minimum a compression test result sheet and leak test evidence), showing stable idle and no smoke/major leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/unknown condition (worst case: may need overhaul).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: engine code/variant not visible, so it may not match the buyer’s vehicle requirements.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and any casting numbers on the block/head, plus a photo showing the exact mounting configuration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/compatibility uncertain (worst case: may not fit without additional parts).

risks.risk: Electrical/control uncertainty: ECU, wiring harness integrity, and sensor functionality are not verifiable from the current witness shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ECU and wiring harness connectors, and a clip showing the harness/ECU powering up (or a diagnostic scan showing no stored critical faults).
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical/control unverified (worst case: may require replacement of ECU/sensors).

risks.risk: Potential damage from disassembly/transport (bent lines, cracked housings, broken mounts, missing fasteners).
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of all ports/hoses connections, mounting points, and any visible cracks/dents, plus a photo of all fasteners/brackets included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly damaged/needs refurbishment (worst case: replacement of damaged parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any engine ID plate/engine code and casting numbers on the block/head.
Photos showing the full completeness of the assembly: starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, wiring harness, all brackets/bolts, and turbo/supercharger parts if present.
A video clip of the engine starting and running (or compression/leak test results).
Close-ups of all ports/hoses connections and mounting points to confirm nothing is cracked or missing.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an engine assembly but provides no readable engine code, no proof of completeness, and no running/test evidence. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative because the exact type/fit and condition cannot be reliably bounded from the current report.
